name: How should I prepare before consulting a contractor about reconfiguring my floor plan?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare before consulting a contractor about reconfiguring my floor plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before bringing in a contractor, pinpoint the specific functional problems with your current layout, such as bottlenecks, lack of storage, or poor lighting. Measure large furniture you plan to keep, gather inspirational layouts, and identify the locations of fixed infrastructure like heating vents and plumbing fixtures. Being clear about your primary goal—whether it is aging-in-place accessibility, hosting guests, or expanding a kitchen work triangle—helps your general contractor design realistic framing and budget plans immediately.
acceptedAnswer.description: List your daily functional pain points, measure key furniture pieces, and identify must-keep fixtures so your contractor can plan framing and mechanical changes.
